features.name: Psionic Power
features.desc: A pool of Psionic Energy Dice (equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus; the die increases up to d12). It fuels Psi-Bolstered Knack (add to a check) and Psychic Whispers (telepathy). Regained on a rest.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, you manifest a Finesse, Thrown psychic blade (range 60 feet) that deals 1d6 + modifier damage; as a Bonus Action, a second blade (1d4 + modifier). Doesn't expend energy dice.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.desc: By expending energy dice: Homing Strikes (add to a miss) and Psychic Teleportation (throw a blade and teleport up to 10 × the result in feet).

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.desc: As an action, you become Invisible for 1 hour; the effect ends when you deal damage or force a creature to make a saving throw. Regained on a Long Rest or by expending an energy die.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.desc: When you deal Sneak Attack damage with your Psychic Blades, you force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw or have the Stunned condition for 1 minute. Can be used again for 3 energy dice.
